i.norm: Verifies {@link CSVRecord#toMap()} on a "short" record: one whose number of values is smaller than the number of declared headers.

The input {@code "a,b"} has only two values, but the format declares three headers ({@code A, B, C}). Converting such a short record to a map must not fail, even though the trailing header {@code C} has no corresponding value.
Must complete without throwing, despite the missing third value.
